```yaml
name: Check System Prompts
on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check-system-prompts:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libssl-dev libpq-dev

      - name: Run system prompt checks
        run: |
          # Check for email usage in trigger/schedule related files
          echo "Checking for email column usage in trigger tables..."
          grep -r "email" src/ --include="*.rs" | grep -E "(trigger|schedule)" | grep -v "permissioned_as" || true
          
          echo "Checking for permissioned_as usage in trigger/schedule related files..."
          grep -r "permissioned_as" src/ --include="*.rs" | grep -E "(trigger|schedule)" || true
          
          echo "Verifying migration logic..."
          grep -r "resolve_email\|resolve_edited_by" src/ --include="*.rs" | wc -l
          
          echo "Checking for synthetic email fallback..."
          grep -r "unknown.windmill.dev" src/ --include="*.rs" || true
          
          echo "Validating group prefix constants..."
          grep -r "PERMISSIONED_AS_USER_PREFIX\|PERMISSIONED_AS_GROUP_PREFIX" src/ --include="*.rs" || true
          
          echo "Checking schedule behavior consistency..."
          grep -r "set_enabled.*email\|create_schedule.*email\|edit_schedule.*email" src/ --include="*.rs" || true
          
          echo "Checking trigger behavior consistency..."
          grep -r "create_trigger\|update_trigger\|set_trigger_mode" src/ --include="*.rs" | grep -E "(permissioned_as|edited_by)" || true
          
          echo "Checking frontend changes..."
          grep -r "OnBehalfOfSelector\|permissionedAs" src/ --include="*.ts" || true
          
          echo "Checking CLI changes..."
          grep -r "permissioned_as.*workspace\|permissioned_as.*export" src/ --include="*.rs" || true
          
          echo "All system prompt checks completed successfully"
```
